categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/node/txorphanage.cpp and txorphanage.h to fix peer orphan eviction logic, carrying the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Prevents an assertion abort in the transaction orphanage when peer counts exceed 3,000. Integer division produces a zero share allowance during trimming, causing LimitOrphans() to crash the daemon on nodes configured with high connection limits.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Test edits in src/test/orphanage_tests.cpp and src/test/fuzz/txorphan.cpp only accompany the p2p orphanage bug fix.
categories.rationale: Does not change general testing infrastructure; test updates specifically pin p2p orphan handling behavior.
